package.title: What If You Aged Like a Greenland Shark?
alt_titles: You Hit Puberty at 150. Here's Why That's Real.
This Shark Was Alive Before the USA. What If You Aged Like It?
description: Greenland sharks grow up so slowly they aren't mature until about 150. What would your life look like on that clock?
The rule: your body ages ten times slower than everyone else's. At 20 you're 2, at 50 you start school, at 150 you're finally a teenager.

The real part: in 2016, scientists radiocarbon-dated the lenses in the eyes of 28 Greenland sharks. The biggest, a 5-metre female, was about 392 years old (somewhere between 272 and 512). Even at the low end, she was born before 1776. They reach maturity at roughly 150 years.
Would you take 400 years if the first 150 were childhood? Tell me in the comments.
sources: Nielsen J. et al. (2016), Eye lens radiocarbon reveals centuries of longevity in the Greenland shark (Somniosus microcephalus). Science 353: 702–704. https://doi.org/10.1126/science.aaf1703
Nature news, 'Greenland shark is longest-lived vertebrate' (2016). https://www.nature.com/articles/nature.2016.20406
